entities.summary: Vera Galushka-Duyunova was a Soviet volleyball player in 1966–74. She was a major player to help Soviet Union women's national volleyball team to dominate the World in late 1960s to early 1970s by winning 1968 Mexico City Olympic Games, 1970 FIVB Women's World Championship, 1972 Munich Olympic Games and 1973 FIVB Women's World Cup in row. She played for Spartak Tashkent.
